title: Window Tinting
description: Premium ceramic and carbon films cut and shrunk in-house. Up to 99% UV rejection, cooler cabins, sharper lines — finished with tucked edges and a lifetime film warranty.

title: Tint Removal
description: Old, bubbled or purple film steamed off safely — no scratched glass, no dead demister lines, no glue residue. Ready for a fresh re-tint the same day.

title: Detailing
description: From daily drivers to garage queens — deep interior extraction, wheel and arch decontamination, and a hand-finished exterior that feels brand new again.

title: Paint Correction
description: Single and multi-stage machine polishing that erases swirls, holograms and oxidation — measured with paint depth gauges and inspected under studio LEDs.

title: Paint Protection
description: Ceramic coatings and graphene coating that lock in the finish for years — hydrophobic, self-healing and backed by real warranties, not promises.
